rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la myi spyod/ mngon par shes pa rnams la myi spyod/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la myi spyod/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la myi spyod/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la myi spyod/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi la myi spyod/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la mi spyod/ byams pa chen po la mi spyod/ snying rje chen po la myi spyod / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa ①brgyad la myi spyod/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la myi spyod/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la myi spyod/phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la myi spyod/ dgra bcom pa nyid la myi spyod/ rang byang chub la mi spyod/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la myi spyod/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la myi spyod do②/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gang spyod pa dang / gang gis spyod pa dang / gang la spyod par 'gyur ba'i chos de dag thams cad mi dmigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni lha dang myi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis myi thub pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis zil gyis gnon par myi nus so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon ma mchis pa'i gnas zil gyis myi non pa la gnas pas/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la bgyid pa dang ma bral ba ni zil gyis myi non pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang nye bar gyur 23—475

pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gal te 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can ji snyed ①pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur te③/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur pa de dag nam 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs ②pa de la rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis rim gror 0byas/bkur sti ⑤byas/ phu dud ⑥byas/ mchod pa byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/rab 'byor de ⑦ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang /rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang /gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas rnam par spyod na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur la/ de dag nam 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs pa la/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis rim gro byas/ bkur sti nibyas/phu dud byas/ mchod pa byas te⑨/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang 23—476

dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal ①bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas rnam par spyod ②na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par mi'i lus thob par gyur te②/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur la/ de dag nam 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs pa la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis rim gro byas/ bkur sti ④byas phu dud byas/mchod pa byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i dubasod nams de'i rgyus ⑥mang du 'phel lam/gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang /'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel 23—477

pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas / rnam par spyod ①na de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo rab 'byor gal te stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur la/de dag nam 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs pa la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis rim gro byas/ bkur sti ②byas/ phu dud byas/ mchod pa byas te/dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang /rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal ②bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas rnam par spyod dun/de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par mi'i lus thob par gyur te⑤/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur la/ de 23—478

dag nam 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs ①pa la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis rim gro byas/ bkur ste ②byas/ phu dud byas/ mchod pa byas te/dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhig pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas rnam par spyod (min/de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi med par mi'i lus thob par gyur la/ de dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / tshad myed pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu bkod pa dang / rang byang chub la rab tu bkod dupa dang / bla na med pa 23—479

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu bkod ①de dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang /gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston na de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur la/de dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang /tshad myed pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu bkod ②pa dang / rang byang chub la rab tu bkod pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu bkod de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 23—480

'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang /gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston na de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo7/ /rab 'byor gal te stong gi ②'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur la/de dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang /tshad med pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu bkod pa dang / rang byang chub la rab tu bkod pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la ②rab tu bkod de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde 23—481

bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston cing 'chad hu)pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang /rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te stong gnyis kyi ②'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ②ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi med par myi'i lus thob par gyur la/de dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang /tshad myed pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu bkod pa dang / rang byang chub la rab tu bkod pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i ④byang chub la rab tu bkod de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu 23—482

phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / hunye'agrel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang /gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur la/ de dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / tshad skyed pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu bkod pa dang / rang byang chub la rab tu bkod pa dang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu bkod de②/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang /23—483

gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/rnam par 'byed pa ni sems can thams cad kyi sbyin pa'i gnas su 'gro ba yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma gtogs par byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ①rnam par spyod pa de lta bu ni sems can gang la yang myed de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rigs kyi bu de ②dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ byams pa chen po mngon par bsgrub ①ste/ de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad gsad par 'gyur ba dang 'dra bar lta ste/ de dag snying rje chen po 'thob bo de dag rnam par spyod pa des/ rnam par spyod pas dga' bas rab tu dga' ba dang / mngon par dga' bar 'gyur te/ de dag dga' ba chen po mngon par sgrub bo/ /de dag mtshan ma de dang lhan cig tu dumi gnas te/ de dag btang snyoms chen po 'thob bo/ /rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi dushes rab kyi snang ba chen po ste/ 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o//bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu de dag ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma yirgyas kyang / sems can thams cad 23—484

kyi sbyin pa'i gnas su 'gyur te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog go/ /de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas rnam par spyod pa'i phyir/ su'i gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal cha dang / nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang / yo byad la yongs su spyod pa'i gtong ba dang / sbyin bdag gi sbyin pa dag par 'gyur te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang yang nye bar 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don yod par khams kyi bsod snyoms la yongs su spyod ①par 'dod pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi ②lam bstan par 'dod pa dang / snang ba chen po dbyung ②bar 'dod pa dang / khams gsum gyi btson ra na gnas pa'i sems can rnams yongs su dgrol bar 'dod pa dang /sems can rnams ①kyi bla na med pa'i shes rab kyi myig bskyed par 'dod pas/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad rjopar gnas par bya'o/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas rnam par mi spyod na yang / des yid la bya ba gzhan gyi go skabs myi dbye ste/ des ci nas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba nyid kyis nyin mtshan dudu mi gtong zhing brtson par gnas pa de ltar bya'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na sngon cad ④nor bu rin po che rnyed ma myong ba'i skyes bu ⑤zhig yod la des dus ⑨gzhan zhig na nor bu rin po che rnyed par gyur te/ des nor bu rin po che de 0rnyed pas dga' ba dang spro ba dang yid bde ba dang ldan par gyur pa las/des nor bu rin po che de rnyed ma thag tu stor bar gyur na/ de'i rgyus sdug 23—485

bsngal ba snarmedang yid mi bde ba chen po dang ldan par 'gyur te rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad ni par kyi hud bdag ni yid du 'ong ba'i nor bu rin po che de dang bral bar gyur to zhes nor bu rin po che dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba sha stag rgyun du 'byung ngo / /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'di ni rin po che'o dusnyam du bsams te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rin po che de stor ④bar yang myi bya ste/ de ltar na rtag tu bde ba dang /yid bde ba mang po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yid la bgyi ba de dag thams cad kyang rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ yid la bgyi ba thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyis stong pa lags na/ ji ltar ⑤byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bgyi khub dang ma bral ba lags/ bral ba la ni byang chub sems dpa' myi dmyigs/ yid la bgyi ba myi dmyigs/⑦ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'di ltar chos thams cad ni rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de dag phyani nyan thos kyis ma byas/ rang sangs rgyas kyis ma byas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang ma mdzad de/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid ⑨dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' 'di ni gnas pa yin no/ /zhes bya bar shes na byang chub sems 23—486

dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ma bral ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin gyis dben/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa ste/ de la 'phel ba myed do/ /yongs su 'grib pa med do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rang bzhin gyis dben zhing rang bzhin gyis stong pa lags na/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ①yang dag par byung zhing /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ②yang dag par byung yang 'phel ba'am yongs su 'grib pa myed de/ de bzhin nyid la 'phel ba'am yongs su 'grib pa med do/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'phel ba'am yongs su 'grib pa myed do/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' la 'phel ba'am yongs su 'grib pa myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gcig kyang ma yin gnyis kyang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor gal te de skad du bshad pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems myi 'jum mi 'gong / myi 'jigs myi sngang ②skrag par mi 'gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni phyir myi ldog pa'i dbyings la gnas pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do zhes bya bar rtogs par rig par bya'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu bdun ④23—487

pa / rab 'byord kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa gang lags pa de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gud na gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i chos gang yang dmigs su mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor ①de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ci lagasal/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ②la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ci lags / stong pa nyid las gud du stong pa nyid nispyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ④ci lags/ gzugs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'du shes shes durab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam / bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'du byed shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par shes pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byord kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 23—488

'das ci lags/ myig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rna ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das/ ci lags/ sna shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lce shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lus shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ yid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ gzugs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sgra shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dri shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ro shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ reg shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ①bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myig gi rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sna'i rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lce'i rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu 23—489

phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byord kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 23—490

spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no / /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sa'i khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/chu'i khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / mye'i khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rlung gi khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ nam mkha'i khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par shes pa'i khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa①/rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ma rig pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'du byed shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mying dang gzugs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ skye mched drug shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/sred ②pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/len pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/srid pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/23—491

skye ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/rga shi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ nang stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / phyi stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ phyi nang stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chen po stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/don dam pa stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 23—492

spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa/ stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dor ba med pa/stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / rang bzhin stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / myi dmigs pa stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no//rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / yang dag par spong ba bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dbang po lnga shes rab kyi 23—493

pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ stobs lnga shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/bsam gtan bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ tshad skyed pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ①bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/rnam par thar pa brgyad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mngon par shes pa rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ting nge 'dzin rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam / bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu shes rab kyi pha rol ②tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod 23—494

dam / bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ snying rje chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca ①brgyad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam / bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dgra bcom pa nyid/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rang byang chub/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/gzugs kyi ②stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang /rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci 23—495

lags / tshor ba'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang /rag lus hunyepa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid snodang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / 'du shes kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin gnyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang /chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'du byed kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang /gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang /de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /23—496

gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/① bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no / /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myig gi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang /chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rna ba'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang /chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sna'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang /snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid ②dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang /23—497

'das pa stong pa nyid kyi 17stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang /chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ②stong pa nyid dang /gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi rjustong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob ④nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid zhudang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ⑦stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de 23—516
