med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / dngos po skyed pa stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ①ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ②stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang /snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ②stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/23—518

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po ba'o brgyad ①pa / /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang /rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / yang dag par spong ba bzhi'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang /gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang /de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i stong pa nyid dang /gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 23—519

spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dbang po lnga'i stong pa nyid dang /gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ stobs lnga'i stong pa nyid dang /gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang /rmye rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang /gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang /23—520

de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings ①dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i stong pa nyid dang /gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ bsam gtan bzhi'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang /snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ tshad myed pa bzhi'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon 23—521

med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi'i stong pa nyid dang /gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang /rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i stong pa nyid dang /gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i 23—522

mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i stong pa nyid dang /gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang /chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos 2skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang /rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci 23—523

lags / gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang /gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang /de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang /snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myi 'jigs ①pa bzhi'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa 23—524

nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byams pa chen po'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang /snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ snying rje chen po'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang /chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa ①brgyad kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang /gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang /de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas 23—525

nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i stong pa nyid dang /gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang /chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de①/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang /rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /khu chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci 23—526

lags / dgra bcom pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang /gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang /de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rang byang chub kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang /snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang /rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang /23—527

ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das gal te chos de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myi spyod na/bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ chos gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i chos de khyod kyis mthong ngam/ gsol pa bcom ldan ①'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom caldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems / gang la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de lta bu khyod kyis mthong ngam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ chos gang khyod kyis ma mthong ba'i chos de dmigs su yod dam/② gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags ①so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ chos gang dmigs su myed pa de skye ba'am 'gag par 'gyur ram/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi myi skye ba'i chos la ④bzod pa ⑤ste/ rab 'byor bzod pa de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub 23—528

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan te/ rab 'byor 'di 'phoni stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi phu)dang / so so yang dag par rig pa ༷ dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i lam zhes bya ste/ lam der zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod ④de ltar rtsol⑤/ de ltar 'bad pa ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes/ ye shes thochen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par myi 'gyur zhes bya ba'i gnas myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i phyir te/de'i chos ⑦de dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du nam yang yongs su 'grib par myi 'gyur ro//rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chos thams cad kyi myi skye ba nyid gang lags pa de las byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par 'gyur ram/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /dugasol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ci skye ba yang ma lags/ myi skye ba yang ma lags pa las byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan tam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te skye ba yang ma lags/ mi skye ba yang ma lags pa las kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 0bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 23—529

byang chub tu lung mi bstan na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par 'gyur ba'i chos de lta bu khyod kyis yang dag par rjes su mthong ngam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags tehu)/ bcom ldan 'das chos gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par 'gyur ba'i chos de dag ni bdag gis yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das chos gang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / gang gis mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / gang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bgyi ba de lta bu'i chos kyang bdag gis yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ chos thams cad myi dmyigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni 'di snyam du bdag ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /'dis ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o/ /'di ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o/ / zhes bya bar gomyi sems so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i rnam par rtog pa de du thams cad skyed pa'i phyir te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ④pa ni rnam par myi rtog pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bzhi bcu lnga'o⑤// //23—530

de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la ①'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du zab pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du blta dka' ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du rtogs ②par dka' ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du brtag tu ma mchis pa'o②/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du brtag pa'i spyod yul ma lags pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du zhi ba phra ba zhib pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du mkhas shing rig pas rtogs par bgyi ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyan cing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang zhing klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / de bzhin nyid du nan tan bgyid cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos gzhan gyi go mi 'byed pa de dag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba tha ma dang ldan pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau ④shi ka de de bzhin no//de de bzhin te/ sems can gong shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyan cing / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang zhing klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du/ sems 23—531

dang sems las byung ba'i chos gzhan gyi go myi 'byed pa de dag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba tha ma 6)dang ldan pa ma yin no/ /kau ②shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan par gyur/ bsam gtan bzhi dang ldan par gyur/ tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan par gyur/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms ③par 'jug pa bzhi dang ldan par gyur/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan par gyur la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig ④kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang la/ klog cing kun chub par byed par gyur ⑤te/ bzung ༷zhing bcangs②ske/ blags ⑧shing kun 0chub par byas nas kyang / de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed na/ kau ⑩shi ka dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la snga ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des brgya'i char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /brgya phrag stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /bye ba'i char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o / /bye ba brgya'i char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba brgya phrag stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /grangs dang cha dang /bgrang ba dang / dpe hudang rgyur yang myi bzod do/ /de nas dge slong gcig cig 8gis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kau ⑩shi ka 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa/ bsam gtan bzhi dang ldan pa/ tshad myed pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa de dag thams cad ni/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu 23—532

phyin ①pa zab mo 'di myi g.yeng ba'i sems kyis 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed cing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos gzhan gyi go myi 'byed pa de dag gis ①zil gyis non to/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dge slong de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa/ bsam gtan bzhi dang ldan pa/ tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang ldan pa/mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ③rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems dang po bskyed pas kyang zil gyis non na/ gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du buyid la byed pa dang / bzung zhing bcangs te/blags 0shing kun chub par byas nas kyang de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed pa lta smos 0kyang ci dgos ⑦te/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis gnon par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des 0ni lha dang myi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan cing 'gro bar yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni rgyun tu zhugs 23—533

pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang ①zil gyis mnan cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas su yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba shide dag kyang zil gyis gnon cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod par yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba rinade dag kyang gzil gyis gnon cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod par yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa thabs rdzunamakhas pa dang bral ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang zil gyis gnon cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod par yang ma zad de/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang zil gyis gnon cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 23—534

la spyod par yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang zil gyis gnon cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod par yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 3)ji skad du bstan pa bzhin du spyod pa de dag ni lha dang myi dang lha ma yin du ②bcas pa'i 'jig rten ①zil gyis ④mnan (5)par myi nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa de ⑥ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ji skad du bstan pa dang mthun par spyod pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rigs rgyun myi gcad ⑦pa'i don du gnas pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni de bzhin gshegs pa ⑧ming du mi byed pa'o/ /de ltar zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni snying po byang chub dang phang lho༄bar myi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni/ sems can bying ba rnams gdon hu 7par 'dod pa'o/ /de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob pa ste / nyan thos kyi bslab pa la slob pa ma yin no/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi bslab pa la slob pa ma yin no/ /de ltar slob pa'i zhu/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du rgyal po chen po bzhi 32dag kyang 'gro bar bya bar sems te nye bar dong hunyezhing 'di skad ces smra'o3 tsho/ /kye skyes bu chen po myur du slobs shig /23—535

skyes bu chen po skyen par slobs shig /lhung bzed 0)bzhi po 'di dag ni khyod kyis snying po byang chub tu 'dug ste/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas blang bar bya ba ②ste/ 'di dag ni sngon ①gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ④bzhes pa'o zhes zer zhing ston to/ /de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du rgyal po chen po bzhi dag kyang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris ⑤kyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'dong ⑥bar sems so/ /de'i drung du bdag kyang sum cu ⑦ma gsum gyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so/ /lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma yang ⑧/mtshe ma'i lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so/ /lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan yang dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so /lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dga' yang / 'phrul dga'i lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so/ /lha'i rgyal po dbang sgyur ⑨yang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so/ /tshangs pa myi mjed kyi bdag po yang tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so/kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dong bar sems so/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dong bar sems so/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dong bar sems so/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dong bar sems sol/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dong bar sems so/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dong bar sems so/ /gya rnam snang ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dong bar sems so/ /gnas gtsang ma'i ris tho )kyi lha 23—536

rnams kyang nye bar 'dong bar sems so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang rtag tu dgongs pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la de ltar spyod pa de'i lus la ni 'jig rten pa'i sdug bsngal gzhan gyis gnod par byas pa gang ji snyed cig lus la 'byung ba de dag kyang thams cad du thams cad lus la myi 'byung ①snyi 'bab ste/ dge slong de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ②la spyod pa'i tshe/'di'i yon tan du 'gyur ba ste/ 'dus pa'i nad rnams gang ji snyed pa 'di lta ste / myig gi nad dam/ rna ba'i nad dam/ sna'i nad dam/ lce'i nad dam/ lus kyi nad dam/ snying gi nad gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang lus la myi 'byung myi 'bab ste/ 'di dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa'i tshe/'di'i yon tan du rig ②par bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun byadaga' bo 'di snyam du gyur te/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di rang gi spobs pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston cing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan dang legs pa rjod dmadu/ 'on te sangs rgyas kyi mthus ston snyam pa dang / de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dudaga' bo'i sems kyi yongs su rtog pa sems kyis yongs su shes nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun ⑦dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa kun rjodaga' bo bdag de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan 23—537

dang legs pa rjod hu)pa ni sangs rgyas kyi mthur rig par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun (snyedaga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun (ge dga' bo de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i yon tan dang / legs pa rjod ④pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu'o / /de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs (geso/ /kun yidaga' bo gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson par byed pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sgom pa de'i tshe/ gang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bdud sdig to can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de 97thams cad ci tshogebyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du byas te/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub thob par 'gyur ram/ 'on te ma yin gyis (pebla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur snyam ste/ dogs pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun spudaga' bo gzhan yang gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ma bral bar gyur pa de'i tshe/ bdud sdig to can mya ngan gyi zug rngus zug par 'gyur ro/ /kun (rnyedaga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin tugepa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bdud sdig to can ci nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di rnam pa 23—538

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la byed pa las sems gcig tsam 'khrug par 'gyur ba dang / zhum par 'gyur ba dang / spu g.yo bar 'gyur bar skar ma lho)ltung bar ②gtong zhing 'jigs pa skyed (kyedo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun ④dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi drung du bdud sdig to can ⑤gtse ba'i bsam pas mchi bar 'gyur ram/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun 6)dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi drung du bdud sdig to can gtse ba'i bsam pas 'ong ba ma yin no/ /kun (7)dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'o na ji lta bu'i drung du mchi bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun ⑧dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' gang gis sngon gyi mthar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bstan ⑨pa'i tshe sems mos par ma byas pa de'i drung du bdud sdig to can gtse ba'i bsam pas nye bar 'ong ngo / /kun pho byedaga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ 'di shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/ 'on tam ma hu7yin zhes the tsom du gyur pa de dag gi drung du bdud sdig to can gtse ba'i bsam pas nye bar 'ong ngo / /kun nyurtedaga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral na/ des dge ba'i bshes hurteganyen myi mthong 1stebs/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di myi thos so/ /ma thos pas myi shes so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ji ltar bsgom pa ma shes pas de bzhin nyid du nan tan myi byed de8/ kun tshedaga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig 23—539

to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun ①dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi pha rol tu ②phyin pa dang bral la/ dam pa'i chos ma yin pa yongs su 'dzin pa byed na/ kun sridaga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun dudaga' bo gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i chos ma yin pa la bsngags pa rjod phyin/ de la bdud dusdig to can 'di snyam du sems te/ gang dam pa'i chos ma yin pa'i bsngags pa smra ba ni bdag gi grogs yin te/ gang dam pa'i chos ma yin pa'i bsngags pa smra ba 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa mang po'i nang nas/ bdag gis grogs su rnyed pa ste/ de ltar gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa 'di lta ste④/nyan thos kyi sa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa gnyis las gcig tu gnas par 'gyur ba ni/ de bdag gi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o snyam ste/ kun ⑧dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun ⑨dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ji lta bu la bdud kyis glags rnyed par 'gyur zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ 'di skad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu zab ste/ khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos pas ci zhig bya/ bsgoms tu )pa dang / bzung ba dang /blags ⑩pa dang / kun chub par byas pas kyang ci zhig bya/ ngas kyang de'i gting ma rnyed na/ khyod kyis lta rnyed re skan zhes bzer na/ kun tsodaga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur 23—540

ro/ /kun ①dga' bo gzhan yang gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan la byang chub sems dpa' brnyas ②pa skyed ①cing / nga ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad ①pa'o/ /nga ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad ⑤pa'o/ /nga ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad 0pa'o/ /nga ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad ⑦pa'o/ /nga ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad ⑧pa'o/ /nga ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad ⑨pa'o / /khyod ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /khyod ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /khyod ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /khyod ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /khyod ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /khyod ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /zhes rlom sems su byed na/ kun tu)dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun skyedaga' bo gzhan yang gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid mchog tu rlom sems skyed tson/kun 0dga' bo de'i tshe bdud sdig to can dga' ba dang / spro ba dang nyams bde ba dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / tshim zhing yid bde ba skye bar 'gyur te/ kun yidaga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun 8dga' bo gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa'i mying brjod pa'am/ rus brjod pa kun tu 8grags par gyur na/de mying brjod pa'am/ rus brjod pa des/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan dge ba'i chos can dag khyad du gsod cing bdag stod tsu pho23—541

gzhan smod la/ phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rnam pa dang tshul dang / mtshan mar bya ba'i yon tan de dag kyang de la myed par rnam pa dang tshul dang / mtshan ma myed pa ①de dag gis nyon mongs pa skyed (gecing bdag stod (migazhan smod de/ 'di skad du ji ltar nga ④byang chub sems dpa'i theg (snyepa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rigs la gnas par snang ba de ltar khyod byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la gnas par mi snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i rigs la gnas par myi snang ngo zhes de de ltar gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa de dag la mi snyan par rjod yicing smod na/ de la bdud sdig to can 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi gnas ni stongs dupar myi 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba chen po dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa 98)dang / yi tsodags ⑩kyi yul yang shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes ci nas kyang de'i tshig gzung du rung bar 'gyur ba 7de lta de ltar bdud sdig to can byang chub sems dpa' de byin gyis rlob ste/ de'i tshig gzung mdu rung bas skye bo mang po dag kyang mnyan pa dang / yid ches hu par bya bar sems te/ de la de dag gis thos sam mthong na/ mthun par spyod par 'gyur te/ de dag gis thos sam mthong nas mthun par spyod cing de bzhin du slob ste/ de dag de bzhin du slob pa'i tshe 0de bzhin nyid du slob cing /de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed pa'i tshe/ nyon mongs pa shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur te/ de ltar de dag bsam pa phyin ci log tu gyur pas/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis nyusnyelas gang dang gang brtsams pa de thams cad mi 'dod pa dang /myi sdug pa dang yid du mi 'ong bar 'grub par 'gyur te/ de ltar na sems can 23—542

dmyal ba chen po de dag kyang rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ byol song gi skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas ①kyi yul yang rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur te/ bdud kyi gnas kyang shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur bas/ kun ②dga' bo don gyi dbang de mthong nas/ bdud sdig to can dga' ba dang /spro ba dang tshim pa dang / yid bde ba skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kun ①dga' bo gzhan yang gal te gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa gang zag nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dang rtsod cing nga ni mchog tu gyur pa yin gyi/ khyod ni ma yin no zhes zer na/ de la dubadud sdig (sheto can 'di snyam du sems te/ kye rigs kyi bu 'di ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ring du byed pa ste/ 'di ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang nye bar 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'thab yimo dang 'khrug pa dang rtsod pa dang mtshang 'dru ⑦ba 'di dag ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam ma yin te/ de ni sems can dmyal ba'i lam mo/ /de ni byol song gi skye gnas kyi lam mo/ /de ni gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi lam mo/ /de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam ma yin no snyam du sems par 'gyur ro/ /kun dudaga' bo gzhan yang gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa dang / gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa can gzhan du 'thab cing rtsod la/ 'khrug cing mtshang ⑨'dru na/ de la bdud sdig to can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di gnyis ka yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ring du byed pa'o/ /'di gnyis ka yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar rigs kyi bu 'di gnyis kyis gang brtsams pa de ni rnam pa 23—543

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam ma yin/ rigs kyi bu 'di gnyis kyis ni sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi lam brtsams so zhes nas dga' zhing spro ba dang / tshim zhing yid bde ba skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kun ①dga' bo gzhan yang gal te byang chub sems dpa' lung ma bstan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' lung bstan pa la gnod par sems shing / 'thab cing rtsod la 'khrug cing mtshang ⑤'dru na/ gal te des rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su mi gtang ①zhe na/ ci 0tsam du sdig pa'i sems bskyed pa skyes pa dang / 'thab cing rtsod ⑤pa dang / 'khrug cing mtshang 'dru bar gyur pa dude srid kyi bskal par go ca ⑦bgo bar bya'o/ /kun ⑧dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de dag gi ⑨sems bskyed pa de dag la 'byung ba gzhan yi mchis sam 'on te ma lags kyis yibaskal pa de snyed kho nar go ca phonyebago 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun 8dga' bo gang zag nyan thos kyi theg pa pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa rnams la ngas 'byung ba dang bcas pa'i chos bstan te/ kun tsunyedaga' bo de la gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i gang zag dang / 'thab cing rtsod tsol gshe zhing myi snyan du brjod ⑩pa dang / 'thabs rtsod ⑩de gshe ba dang / myi snyan par brjod 8pa byas nas/ phyir myi 'chags 0par mdud par 'dzin cing khon tu bzung pyo )ste gnas na/ kun (nyedaga' bo gang zag de ni 'byung bar nga mi smra ste/ gang zag des gal te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid tsoyongs su myi btang rdu )zhe na/ gdon mi za bar bskal pa de snyed du go ca (stebago 23—544

bar bya'o/ /kun ①dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'thabs shing rtsod ②de gshe ba dang mi snyan par brjod par gyur na yang /mdud par mi 'dzin la phyin chad sdom pa ①'dzin cing / bdag gis ni thob par bya ba nyes par 0thob ste/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bstsal ⑤dgos na/ de ltar bdag smras pa la phyir smra ba dang / bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi zam par gyur par dubya dgos na/ de ltar ⑦bdag gzhan la myi snyan par smra zhing / phyir zlogs ⑧pa ni myi tshul gyisal/bdag gis de ltar myi bya'i ⑩bdag gis glen pa dang ⑪/ lkug pa bzhin du bya'o//bdag gi 4)bsam pa la 'khrug pa med par bya'o/ /sems can 'di dag ni bdag gis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ yongs su mya ngan las 0bzla ④bar bya dgos na/ de dag nyid la bdag ngan sems su byed pa dang / de dag nyid la bdag 'khrug pa ni tshul ma yin gyisatunye/ bdag gis de dag la gnod sems su mi bya'o/ /bdag gis de dag la 'khrug par mi bya'o snyam na/ kun hunyedaga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni 'byung ba yod par ngas bshad de⑩/ de la ni bdud sdig to can glags lta zhing glags tshol bas kyang glags mi rnyed do/ /kun phyedaga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gang zag nyan thos kyi theg pa pa yidag dang 'grogs 0par myi bya'o/ /de dag dang lhan cig tu gnas par myi bya'o/ /'dug par mi bya'o/ /gal te 'dug na yang des su la yang gnod sems su mi bya du'akhrug par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gang bdag gis 'di dag la gnod sems su bya ba dang / 'khrug par bya ba de 23—545

ni bdag la myi tshul lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag ni bdag ①gis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su dgrol bar bya ba dag go snyam du bya'o/ /kun dudaga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa dag dang gnas par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun medaga' bo 'di lta ste dper na/ ston pa dang ji ltar gnas pa de bzhin du/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa dang gnas par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni bdag gi skyigrogs te gru gcig tu zhugs pa'o/ /'dis kluji ltar bslab par bya ba de bzhin du bdag gis kyang bslab par bya'o/ /'dis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /tshul khrims sa kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang /chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad ⑦stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang /23—546

dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang /dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag ①brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang /bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang /ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o thubargyad dang / thams cad shes pa nyid dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang la bslab par bya ba de nyid la bdag gis kyang bslab par bya'o/ /snyam du sems bskyed do/ /des zhugazhan yang sems 'di ltar bskyed par byas te pya/'di ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam ⑤ston phyopa ste/ gal te de 'dres par spyod cing rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang bral bar gyur na/ de la bdag gis bslab par mi bya'iphya/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang / ma bral bar gnas na/ bdag gis kyang de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /snyam du sems bskyed de/ de ltar slob pa'i byang chub 23—547

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni bslab pa mnyam pa ①yin no/ / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bzhi bcu drug go②// //①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu dgu mepa / de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byord kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsold to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos mnyam pa nyid gang la bslab par bgyi ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsald pa/ rab 'byord nang stong pa nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byord phyi stong pa nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byord phyi nang stong pa nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byord chen po stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor don dam pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byord 'dus byas stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems 23—548

dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byord rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /①gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong / tshor ba ni tshor bas stong / 'du shes ni 'du shes kyis stong / 'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong / rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong / myig ni myig gis stong / rna ba ni rna bas stong / sna ni snas stong / lce ni lces stong /lus ni lus kyis stong / yid ni yid kyis stong / gzugs ni gzugs ②kyis stong / sgra ni sgras stong / dri ni dris stong / ro ni ros stong / reg ni reg gis stong ③/ chos ni chos kyis stong / myig gi rnam par shes pa ni myig gi 23—549

rnam par shes pas stong / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni rna ba'i rnam par ①shes pas stong / sna'i rnam par shes pa ni sna'i rnam par shes pas stong / lce'i rnam par shes pa ni lce'i rnam par shes pas stong / lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni lus kyi rnam par shes pas stong / yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni yid kyi rnam par shes pas stong / myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pas stong /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pas stong / sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni sna'i 'dus te reg pas stong / lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni lce'i 'dus te reg pas stong / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pas stong /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pas stong / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong / sa'i khams ni sa'i khams kyis stong / chu'i khams ni chu'i khams kyis stong / mye'i khams ni mye'i khams kyis stong / rlung gi khams ni rlung gi khams kyis stong / nam mkha'i khams ni nam mkha'i khams kyis stong /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni rnam par shes pa'i khams kyis stong / ma rig pa ni ma rig pas stong / 'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong / rnam par shes pa ni 23—550

rnam par shes pas stong / mying dang gzugs ni mying dang gzugs kyis stong /skye mched drug ni skye mched drug gis stong / reg pa ni reg pas stong / tshor ba ni tshor bas stong / srid pa ni sred pas stong / len pa ni len pas stong /srid pa ni srid pas stong / skye ba ni skye bas stong / rga shi ni rga shis stong /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong / nang stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid kyis stong / phyi stong pa nyid ni phyi stong pa nyid kyis stong /phyi nang stong pa nyid ni phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis stong / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong / chen po stong pa nyid ni chen po stong pa nyid kyis stong / don dam pa stong pa nyid ni don dam pa stong pa nyid kyis stong /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis stong / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis stong / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa snyed kyis stong / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong / rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis stong / chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni rang 23—551

gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid ni mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyis stong / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ①ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong / yang dag par spong ba rnams ni yang dag par spong ba rnams kyis stong / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyis stong / dbang po rnams ni dbang po rnams kyis stong / stobs rnams ni stobs rnams kyis stong / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis stong / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas ②stong / 'phags pa'i bden pa ②rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis stong / bsam gtan rnams ni bsam gtan rnams kyis stong / tshad myed pa rnams ni tshad skyed pa rnams kyis stong /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni gzugs skyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis ④stong / rnam par thar pa rnams ni rnam par thar pa rnams kyis stong / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med pa ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med pas stong /mngon par shes pa rnams ni mngon par shes pa rnams kyis stong / ting nge 'dzin rnams ni ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis stong / gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni 23—552

gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis stong / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyis stong / mi 'jigs pa rnams ni mi 'jigs pa rnams kyis stong / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyis stong / ①snying rje chen po ni snying rje chen pos stong /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi ②chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyis stong / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni ①rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bus stong / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong /dgra bcom pa nyid ni dgra bcom pa nyid kyis stong / rang byang chub ni rang byang chub kyis stong / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis stong / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis stong ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid de/ de la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o④/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzugs bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ gzugs 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ gzugs 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ gzugs mi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/23—553

tshor ba bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ tshor ba 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ tshor ba 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ tshor ba myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du shes bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du shes 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du shes 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du shes mi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du byed bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob ①na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du byed 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du byed 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du byed myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa ②lags sam/ rnam par shes pa bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ rnam par shes pa 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/rnam par shes pa 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad 23—554

mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ rnam par shes pa myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ myig bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ①slob pa lags sam/ myig 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ myig 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob ②na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/myig myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ rna ba bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ rna ba 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam / rna ba 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ rna ba myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ sna bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ sna 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ sna 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ sna mi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob srin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/lce bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ lce 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ lce 'gag par bgyi 23—555

ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/lalce myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ lus bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ lus 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam / lus 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ lus myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ yid bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/yid 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ yid 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ yid myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/gzugs bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ gzugs 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/gzugs 'gag par bgyi ①ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ gzugs myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ sgra bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ sgra 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad 23—556

mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ sgra 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ sgra mi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/dri bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ dri 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ dri 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/dri mi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ ro bas ①par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ ro 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob phyin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob ②pa lags sam/ro 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob ④na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ ro mi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob ⑤na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ reg bas 0par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/reg 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ reg 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ reg myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ chos bas ⑦par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ chos 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi dhi23—557

'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ sa'i khams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/chu'i khams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am / 'gag par 'gyur ram/ mye'i khams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rlung gi khams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am / 'gag par 'gyur ram/ nam mkha'i khams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am / skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ ma rig pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram / 'du byed kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rnam par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/mying dang gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ skye mched drug gi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/reg pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/23—618

'gag par 'gyur ram/ tshor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ sred pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram / len pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ srid pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ skye ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rga shi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am / skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/'gag par 'gyur ram/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am / skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid lkugang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/'gag par 'gyur ram/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am / spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ nang stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/'gag par 'gyur ram/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad 23—619

pa'am / spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/'gag par 'gyur ram/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am / 'gag par 'gyur ram/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram༅ / 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/'gag par 'gyur ram/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am / spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am / skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 23—620

kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/'gag par 'gyur ram/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/'gag par 'gyur ram/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/yang dag par spong ba bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am / skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ dbang po lnga'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ stobs lnga'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i ①de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ bsam gtan bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ tshad myed pa bzhi'i de 23—621

bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram / rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am / skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/mngon par shes pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin ①pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am / skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am / spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'amatshu/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ myi 'jigs pa ②bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ so so yang dag par rig pa ②bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/snying rje chen po'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am / 'gag par 'gyur ram/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa 23—622

brgyad ①kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/'gag par 'gyur ram/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/'gag par 'gyur ram/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyi ②de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rang byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am / 'gag par 'gyur ram/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni de bzhin nyid la slob pa ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la slob pa yinani/ de bzhin nyid ni zad pa'am/spang ba'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ba myed de/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni de bzhin nyid la slob pa ste / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu du23—623

phyin pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ nang stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/phyi stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ phyi nang stong —pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ chen po stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/don dam pa stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang 23—624

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ myi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub 23—625

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ dbang po lnga la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ stobs lnga la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i ①byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ bsam gtan bzhi la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ tshad myed pa bzhi la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa ②la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ting nge 'dzin rnams la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub 23—626

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la slob ①pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ ②snying rje chen po la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa khyabargyad la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ dgra bcom pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ rang byang chub la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ lam gyi rnam pa ⑤shes pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la slob pa yin/rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/23—627

bslab pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'thob ①par 'gyur ba yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ bdud dam bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis ②pham par myi nus pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni / myur du phyir myi ldog pa'i sa 'thob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ bdag gi pha ④de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul la spyod pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni mgon du 'gyur ba'i chos rnams la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ byams pa chen po la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni ②snying rje chen po la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir slob pa yinagye/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 2chen po ni/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni rnam pa bcu gnyis lan gsum du bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sems can thams cad yongs su sbyin par bya'o zhes slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rgyun myi gcad ⑧pa'i phyir slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems 23—628
